name: DMTet Surface Reconstruction with Eikonal Regularization
definition: Defines object geometry as a Signed Distance Field (SDF) on a tetrahedral mesh T. Each vertex $v_i$ has an SDF value $S_i \in \mathbb{R}$ and a deformation value $\Delta v_i \in \mathbb{R}^3$. The mesh is updated as $v_i' = v_i + \Delta v_i$.
